title: Agent Capability & Efficiency Matrix
description: Root schema for the canonical Agent Matrix specification (v1.6.0)

agent_profiles.description: Canonical agent archetypes recognized by the matrix.

matrix_composition.description: Optional. Matrix overlays, named profiles, section imports, and inheritance semantics.

sla_qos.description: Optional. Formal service-level objectives, indicators, error budgets, and breach events.

cloudevents_binding.description: Optional. CloudEvents envelope mapping for portable event emission.

agent_registry.description: Optional. Runtime agent registry, discovery, health, readiness, and warm-standby policy.

identity_lifecycle.description: Optional. General agent identity, authentication, key lifecycle, and federation policy.

prompt_context_governance.description: Optional. Prompt versioning, context schema, injection defenses, RAG, and caching controls.

audit_integrity.description: Optional. Tamper-evident audit log hash chaining, export, retention, and verification.

a2a_binding.description: Optional. Agent-to-Agent protocol binding for cross-vendor discovery, negotiation, and task exchange.

federated_orchestration.description: Optional. Multi-orchestrator topology, leadership, cross-cluster handoff, and data residency policy.

compliance_mapping.description: Optional. EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and other compliance framework mappings.

runtime_api_service.description: Optional. Runtime API surface, SDK contract, server deployment, and compatibility policy.

mcp.description: Optional. MCP (Model Context Protocol) alignment. Omit if the deployment does not use MCP.

streaming_output.description: Optional. Streaming output envelope, sequence numbering, terminal chunk marker, and backpressure policy.

prompt_injection_defense.description: Optional. Prompt injection attack taxonomy, detection hook contract, rejection rules, and audit obligations.

workflow_patterns.description: Optional. Named, versioned workflow pattern library for reusable multi-agent coordination profiles.
